_game: COOM: Run and Gun (Doom continual-RL suite; own scenario, not stock ViZDoom)
_note: Needs the TTomilin/COOM repo checked out somewhere and COOM_REPO set to it (or pass --coom-repo) -- the coom backend reads its conf.cfg/.wad scenario assets directly, it does not pip install the COOM package (which pins a conflicting gymnasium version). env_kwargs.task picks a WAD variant (default 'default'; also 'blue'/'red'/'green'/'hard'/'monsters'/'obstacles'/'resized'/'shadows').
_audio_note: Requires OpenAL (Ubuntu: sudo apt install libopenal1). Native stereo PCM at 44100 Hz, one Doom tic per step: keep fps=35. EFX reverb is explicitly disabled. --no-audio mutes playback but preserves logged PCM. MIDI music also requires a working engine MIDI renderer; check the engine startup log.
_keys_note: COOM's Discrete(12) action table (turn x move x execute): 0=noop, 1=execute, 2=forward, 3=forward+execute, 4=turn right, 6=turn right+forward, 8=turn left, 10=turn left+forward. For run_and_gun the 4th ('execute') button is ATTACK, on SPACE below; 'noop' is 0. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Locate and shoot the enemies scattered around
the maze. You have unlimited ammunition.
